# Lux Education Partners

> Luxembourg-based support for international families placing a child in school:
> admissions coordination, host family and guardianship arrangements in line with
> each school's policy, and arrival support. Operated by Silver Bay Mountain Group
> S.à r.l. (RCS B293621), Luxembourg.

Founder and author: James Liu (刘一卜), 20+ years in international education.
Author page: https://luxedupartners.lu/authors/james-liu/

## What is here
Decision guides for families choosing between real options in Luxembourg and
Switzerland. Each guide states a direct answer, the evidence class behind it
(government regulation / school confirmation / observed cases / professional
judgment), what still requires individual assessment, and official sources.

## Languages
Chinese and English carry the full set of guides. French covers pages addressed
to schools and institutions. Chinese is the language of authorship; English
pages are translations.

## Important
Admissions decisions are made solely by the school. Nothing here promises an
admission outcome, and nothing here is legal or immigration advice.
